summary: Iteration-2 testing green. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed against public URL (config now includes sound_detection + mamie_phone with PUT persistence; POST/GET/PATCH /api/activities including confirmed→confirmed_at, cancelled, 404; scheduler auto-flip scheduled→awaiting_confirmation observed within ~15s of end_at when polled; POST/GET/PATCH /api/photo-requests including refused + 404; multipart upload to /api/photo-requests/{id}/photo returns fulfilled + photo_path and GET /api/photos/{id} returns image bytes with image/* Content-Type — Emergent object storage integration works). Frontend on mobile viewport 390x844: Mamie home renders THREE giant buttons (mamie-bedtime-button, mamie-shower-button, mamie-sos-button); shower press creates activity and shows 'Bonne douche' toast; after seeding an already-past activity, activity-prompt-banner appears within ~15s and activity-done-button confirms it (banner disappears + 'Merci' success toast); after seeding a pending photo request the photo-request-modal appears with both photo-accept and photo-refuse (refuse closes the modal). Dashboard status: request-photo shows 'Demande envoyée' toast and after uploading a photo via API the latest-photo Image renders; open-activities navigates to /activities. /activities screen: activity-title + activity-add creates 'TEST_UI_Marché' and shows it in the list; activity-cancel buttons are present (3 rows). Dashboard settings: input-mamie-phone persisted to '0611223344', sound-on sets sound_detection=true — both verified via GET /api/config. Dashboard map: map-call-mamie visible and shows 'Appeler Mamie : 0611223344' toast on web (Linking.openURL used on native, correctly gated). No red screens, no error console noise blocking use.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py activity_monitor is a single asyncio task started at app startup; if uvicorn spawns multiple workers this becomes duplicated. In this env it is single-worker (supervisor) — OK for MVP, but consider a leader lock for production scaling.
server.py upload_photo uses put_object which re-inits storage on 503 (good). init_storage failure is only logged and swallowed at startup — subsequent uploads will still try to init lazily (good).
PhotoRequest.status has both 'accepted' and 'fulfilled' — the dashboard uses .some(p.status==='pending'||p.status==='accepted') to show 'En attente' hint (good).
Activity kind literal is only 'activity'|'shower' — frontend dashboard/activities uses 'activity'; Mamie shower uses 'shower' with a 5-minute grace and 15-minute end_at (matches spec).
parse_iso safely handles missing/invalid ISO and returns now (good), preventing crash of the monitor loop.

Frontend PhotoRequestModal uses expo-camera (CameraView) which is native-only for capture — modal display and refuse path work on web (verified). Capture requires a device build (expected, per review note).
Frontend dashboard/settings save posts full config including empty mamie_phone / dashboard_pin fallback '1234' — good.
Frontend map.tsx correctly gates Linking.openURL('tel:') to non-web and shows a toast on web (verified).
